title: docs(adr): repoint three security-plugin.ts symbol anchors to declarations the class keeps

_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuACdPWFJTLDcTrByFCHLzqb)_

Fixes #25314
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Ruling-ref: 6353073966

**Tier H (`docs/adr/**`, AGENTS.md Prime Directive 14): this PR stays a draft and lands only on an APPROVED review by a `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` account. No seat readies, queues or arms auto-merge on it.**

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么** — 三个 ADR 锚点的拼写,别无其它(无正文改动、无 `anchor-exempt` 标记、无其它文件)。路径前缀均为 `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-plugin.ts`:

| 位置 | 之前 | 之后 | 理由 |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| ADR-0055:26 | `#sharingModel`(读派生 `computeControlledByParentFilter` 内的局部 `const`) | 文件级锚点(去掉 `#symbol`) | 句子讲的是 #1994 按 id 写前像复读,即 `start()` 中间件内联的 step 2.7,没有自己的符号;门禁头注对此的处方就是「drop to a file-level `path`」 |
| ADR-0055:58 | `#controlled_by_parent`(读派生里的三处字符串字面量,`literal` 级) | `#assertControlledByParentWrite` | §3 描述的正是这个 step 2.8 主表编辑闸:解析主表 id、按主表 edit 写过滤复读、`null` 即拒;本 ADR 第 125 行 "What both halves do now" 的 Write 条已用同一锚点 |
| ADR-0123:4 | `#refuseNoActiveOrganization`(`composeWriteTenantWall` 内的局部闭包) | `#composeWriteTenantWall` | 句子说 D2 的拒绝「从唯一拼写处抛出 … step 3.7」;该方法就是 step 3.7 Layer 0 写租户墙的唯一组合处,闭包住在它里面 |

**为什么改** — #25223 的只搬不改拆分要把这些函数体搬出 `security-plugin.ts`;旧锚点只靠函数体内的 token 碰巧拼写相同才解析,一搬就 `unresolved-symbol`(在撤回的五体切头 `94ef3e320f` 上已复现)。新目标是拆分各切都保留在类上的方法声明(或文件本身),之后任何搬动都不会再悄悄弄断它们。

**风险与代价(含回滚)** — 零运行时影响,只动 3 行文档。回滚即 revert 本 PR。

**席位意见** —

**你要做的** — 审阅三处新指向是否对得上句子;同意即 APPROVE。若不同意其中某处,点名改法即可(候选见裁决 `6353073966` 第 3 条)。

## Why each target (one line each)

- **ADR-0055:26 → file-level.** The sentence describes the pre-existing #1994 by-id pre-image re-read (`2.7. Row-level WRITE authorization (pre-image check).`, inline in the `start()` middleware) — no symbol of its own exists, and the ruling's other candidate `#checkControlledByParentWrite` re-reads the MASTER, not "the target row under the write-op RLS filter", so the gate header's file-level remedy is the honest pointer.
- **ADR-0055:58 → `#assertControlledByParentWrite`** (not the ruling's first candidate `#checkControlledByParentWrite`). §3's sentence is the master-edit write gate for `update`/`delete`/`create`: resolve the master id, re-read the master under its edit write filter, deny on `null`. That is `assertControlledByParentWrite` (step 2.8, `:9654`), which the middleware calls directly. `checkControlledByParentWrite` (`:9492`) is the served `ISecurityService` member that wraps it for one by-id `update` and returns an outcome instead of throwing. ADR-0055:125 already anchors the write half to `#assertControlledByParentWrite`, and ruling `6353073966` lists it among the method shells the class keeps across every cut. If the maintainer prefers the ruling's candidate, it is a one-token amend.
- **ADR-0123:4 → `#composeWriteTenantWall`.** Step 3.7's Layer 0 tenant write wall, "the ONE spelling of the wall's judgement of a row" by its own docblock; the `refuseNoActiveOrganization` closure lives inside it.

## Anchor readings

Measured with `extractAnchors` / `symbolSegmentResolution` / `symbolResolutionClass` from `scripts/symbol-anchors.mjs` (comments stripped as the gate strips them), on `origin/main` `258f4e6aa` (base) and this head `0dafb657eb`; `security-plugin.ts` is byte-identical in both.

| anchor | before: class · line(s) | after: class · line(s) |
|:--|:--|:--|
| ADR-0055:26 | `#sharingModel` · declaration · `:9208` (local `const` in `computeControlledByParentFilter`) | file-level (path only, still checked) |
| ADR-0055:58 | `#controlled_by_parent` · literal · `:9035`, `:9209`, `:9275` | `#assertControlledByParentWrite` · declaration · `:9654` |
| ADR-0123:4 | `#refuseNoActiveOrganization` · declaration · `:8499` (local closure in `composeWriteTenantWall`) | `#composeWriteTenantWall` · declaration · `:8432` |

`node scripts/check-adr-symbol-anchors.mjs` (under `os-verify-lock`):

- base `258f4e6aa`: exit 0 — 2383 anchors across 142 records resolve — 467 symbol (440 declaration, 27 literal), 1888 file-level.
- head `0dafb657eb`: exit 0 — 2383 anchors across 142 records resolve — 466 symbol (440 declaration, 26 literal), 1889 file-level.

The declaration count is flat, not +1: ADR-0055:58 moves literal → declaration (+1) and ADR-0055:26 moves declaration → file-level (−1). The literal count drops by one.

## Tests and gates

Docs-only diff; no package touched, so no build closure, no package tests, no ablation.

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at `0dafb657eb` derived 20 families for the two changed paths; each ran under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`, all exit 0: `check-adr-links` (+ `--self-test`), `check-adr-symbol-anchors` (+ `--self-test`), `check-ci-filter-parity`, `check-closing-keyword-parity` (+ `--self-test`), `check-comment-mask-corpus`, `@objectstack/lint check:doc-formula-expressions` (first run exit 3 PREREQUISITE NOT MET; re-run exit 0 after the prescribed `turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/formula --filter=@objectstack/lint`), `check:adr-anchors`, `check:closed-ceremony-text`, `check:cross-package-test-inputs`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:driver-memory-census`, `check:gitlink-declared`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:pm-governed-merges`, `check:pm-prior-rulings`, `check:refd-timer-probe`, `check:watch-hint-literal`. `--ran` reconciliation: 20 derived, 20 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a derived zero, every line carrying its exit code).

## Changeset

None: `docs/adr/**` publishes nothing from any released package, so this PR carries `skip-changeset`.

## Acceptance notes

- `#checkControlledByParentWrite` resolves as `declaration` on three lines, not one: the method at `:9492` and two object-literal service members at `:2442` and `:5346`. It is not used by this PR; noted for whoever amends ADR-0055:58 to it.
- ADR-0055:58's sentence says "In the pre-image block"; the master-edit gate is step 2.8, the block right after the step 2.7 pre-image check, and it covers six operations (`insert`/`update`/`delete`/`transfer`/`restore`/`purge`) where the sentence names three. The sentence reads narrower than the code, not false; no prose was changed here (gate header: "Do not repair prose to clear this gate"). Carrier: none.
- A file-level anchor is not judged by symbol, so a later cut that moves the step 2.7 middleware out of `security-plugin.ts` (the cut-9+ plan) will not red on ADR-0055:26; that cut's own anchor map (ruling `6353073966` item 2) is what covers it.
